name: com.aivideogt/ai-video-gt
title: AI Video GT
description: Make AI videos and images with your AI Video GT credits, check prices and find free video tools.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Use first, before generating, to pick a model and quote its price. Lists every AI Video GT video and image model with its aspect ratios, resolutions, clip lengths, whether it is accepting jobs right now, and the exact credits each option costs. No key needed.

kind.description: Only video or only image models.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Use to tell the user how many credits a video or image will cost before making it. Returns the exact credits for a model at a given resolution and, for video, clip length. No key needed.

resolution.description: One of the model's resolutions. Defaults to its lowest.

duration.description: Video only: clip length in seconds, one of the model's durations. Defaults to its shortest.

tools.name: find_video_tool
tools.description: Use when the user wants to edit a video file they already have: trim, cut, crop, resize, compress, convert, merge, add music, extract audio, make a GIF, record the screen and more. Returns free AI Video GT tools that run in the browser (the file never leaves the user's device), with links. No key needed.

query.description: What the user wants to do, e.g. "compress", "mp4 to gif", "add music". Leave out to list every tool.

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Use when the user asks for a new AI video from a text description. Spends credits from the user's AI Video GT account (quote the price with estimate_cost first) and waits until the clip is ready, usually 10 seconds to 3 minutes, then returns its URL. If the call times out, find the result with list_generations. Failed generations are refunded automatically. Needs the user's AI Video GT account: sign-in (OAuth) or a Developer API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer vgt_...`.

prompt.description: The shot to make: subject, action, setting, camera, light and any sound.

aspect_ratio.description: One of the model's aspect ratios, e.g. 16:9 or 9:16. Defaults to the first.

resolution.description: One of the model's resolutions, e.g. 720p. Defaults to the lowest.

duration.description: Clip length in seconds, one of the model's durations. Defaults to the shortest.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Use when the user asks for a new AI image from a text description. Spends credits from the user's AI Video GT account (quote the price with estimate_cost first), waits until the image is ready and returns its URL. Failed generations are refunded automatically. Needs the user's AI Video GT account: sign-in (OAuth) or a Developer API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer vgt_...`.

aspect_ratio.description: One of the model's aspect ratios, e.g. 1:1 or 16:9. Defaults to the first.

resolution.description: One of the model's resolutions, e.g. 1K, 2K or 4K. Defaults to 1K.

tools.name: get_generation
tools.description: Use to check one generation by id: status pending, done or failed, its file URL when done, and its cost. Needs the user's AI Video GT account: sign-in (OAuth) or a Developer API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer vgt_...`.

tools.name: list_generations
tools.description: Use to find the user's recent videos and images, newest first, for example after a generate call timed out. Needs the user's AI Video GT account: sign-in (OAuth) or a Developer API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer vgt_...`.

limit.description: How many to return (default 10, at most 50).

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Use to show the user's AI Video GT plan and credit balance. Needs the user's AI Video GT account: sign-in (OAuth) or a Developer API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer vgt_...`.
